verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents an exit path from LiveKit Cloud to self-hosting on its open-source server, and its own Egress feature can record media to open formats such as MP4 and HLS. There is no documented way to export all account or project data (agent configs, logs, metrics, transcripts) in open formats. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all user/account data, an explicit list of export formats for non-media data, and independent corroboration of a completed migration off Cloud.
